thesis: World-class Awwwards animation sites win with restraint: two-tone chrome, massive type hierarchy, scroll-scrubbed chapters, staggered timeline entrances, modular motion primitives — never palette chaos. Map that discipline onto QUANTANIUM pristine-ice-lake (abyss + ice chrome) for documentary intelligence UX.

lessons.lesson: Limit chrome to two values; reserve hue for data only
lessons.quantanium_map: abyss #02040a / ice chrome #eef6fa; semantic hues only on severity chips

lessons.lesson: Display type IS the layout — huge heads, airy body, mono labels
lessons.quantanium_map: --slate-text-6xl hero; Atkinson display; IBM Plex Mono eyebrows

lessons.lesson: Storytelling via scroll progress, not page dumps
lessons.quantanium_map: documentary chapters + presentation slide snap + progress rail

lessons.lesson: Stagger children on reveal (timeline API), fixed easing
lessons.quantanium_map: pres-slide nth-child delays; --slate-ease-out; max 8 staggered children

lessons.lesson: Reusable motion primitives, not one-off CSS fireworks
Show one idea per viewport; detail on demand
lessons.quantanium_map: daily briefing: headline → metrics rail → findings → future map

lessons.lesson: Same content must work as passive film and interactive site
lessons.quantanium_map: LIRIL documentary: WATCH mode auto-advance + NAV mode chapter scrubber

lessons.lesson: Luxury = empty ice, not denser chrome

implementation_targets.tokens: css/tokens.css v1.5.0 cinematic motion + display scale

quantum_validation.method: PRISM max_spec + agentic smoke + design lap artifact
quantum_validation.expected: CINEMATIC_DOC_ACTIVE when files present; LIVE only if container + GATE_PASS
